593:t_056:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Good...! Keep it up and intercept the enemy!」

593:t_056:1.en:
$$ミネバ$$
($c... If it's you, I believe you can overcome any hardship.)

593:t_100:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! Are you really going to fight no matter what!?」

593:t_100:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「So you've finally got the fight in you, $$バナージ$$!」

593:t_100:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「No...! $$バナージ$$ isn't fighting to defeat you! He's fighting to talk with you!」

593:t_100:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「At this point, you're still spouting such nonsense!」

593:t_100:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「No matter what anyone says, I'll act the way I believe is right!」

593:t_100:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's why, Ensign $$リディ$$! I'm fighting to stop you!」

593:t_101:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「With this power, even if my opponent is Captain $$アムロ$$...!」

593:t_101:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Sharpen your mind, Ensign $$リディ$$! Right now you're drowning in your emotions and losing sight of what matters!」

593:t_101:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The talent in you that I had hopes for surely didn't awaken so you could do something like this!」

593:t_101:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「I... have no choice but to do this!」

593:t_101:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't excuse yourself by going with the flow, $$リディ$$! Remember what really matters to you!」

593:t_102:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! The fight between you and me shouldn't be settled like this!」

593:t_102:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「That's in the past, $$カミーユ$$! If you get in my way, I'll shoot you down as an enemy too!」

593:t_102:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I won't lose to someone drowning in their emotions!」

593:t_102:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Wake up, Ensign! It's wrong to express your purity in a form like this!」

593:t_103:0.en:
$$シン$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! If you've become one of $$クロノ$$, I won't hesitate to fight!」

593:t_103:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「That's the way, $$シン$$! I'll break through you and strike $$バナージ$$... the $$ユニコーン$$!」

593:t_103:2.en:
$$シン$$
「Damn it! Do you think I actually want to fight you, Ensign!?」

593:t_103:3.en:
$$シン$$
「Get ready, Ensign! To wake you up, I'm going to do this the rough way!」

593:t_104:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! I believe the you now and the you who fought with us on $$オーブ$$ are the same!」

593:t_104:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Don't think words like that will make me flinch, $$キラ$$! I'm the man who turned against you all to protect the world!」

593:t_104:2.en:
$$キラ$$
「Even so! You still have the same pure heart you had back then!」

593:t_104:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「That's why I'll stop you, so that heart of yours turns in the right direction!」

593:t_105:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If you come at me, I'll just take you down.」

593:t_105:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「That's the way! I swore to lay down my life to protect the world!」

593:t_105:4.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Words meant to show you'll die for your mission only sound like bluster to me.」

593:t_105:5.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I can't let a man like that keep fighting any longer...!」

593:t_106:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「Keep a strong heart! Right now you're being consumed by that Gundam!」

593:t_106:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「This $$バンシィ$$ has become my hands and feet, the power to protect the world! You've got no right to lecture me!」

593:t_106:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「Rejecting others with force like that won't end the fighting!」

593:t_106:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「If you open your heart, that Gundam should show even more power than it does now!」

593:t_106:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「What I need now is the power to strike you down! $$バンシィ$$ lends me that!」

593:t_107:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「The you I heard rumors about and the you in front of me are way too different!」

593:t_107:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Say what you like! I chose this path of my own will!」

593:t_107:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If that means chasing $$バナージ$$, it doesn't sound like much of a resolve!」

593:t_107:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I don't know what happened to you, but if you're going after my friends, you're my enemy!」

593:t_107:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Here I come! I've got no strings attached, so I'll be the one to stop you!」

593:t_108:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Please stop fighting! Nobody wants to fight you!」

593:t_108:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Then get out of the way! Don't interfere with my fight with $$バナージ$$!」

593:t_108:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「We're trying to stop you because we don't want to see you and $$バナージ$$ fight!」

593:t_108:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「If you still won't understand that, then I have ideas of my own!」

593:t_109:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
($$リディ$$... Go beyond your own limits.)

593:t_109:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
(Go beyond your emotions, your thoughts, your ties, your past! Then you'll be able to face yourself far more honestly!)

593:t_109:2.en:
$$ブライト$$
(You're not a man who ends in a place like this!)

593:t_110:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$...! I'll stop you and knock that attitude of yours back into shape!」

593:t_110:1.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
(Please understand, Ensign $$リディ$$... We have reasons we can't back down, either.)

593:t_111:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「Out of my way, $n! Don't think you can stop me!」

593:t_111:1.en:
$n
「That's my line! Don't think you can break through me!」

593:t_111:3.en:
$n
「I'll repay you for the training you gave me! By stopping your fight with $$バナージ$$!」

593:t_112:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I've been dying to see you, $n! Now, a match with the $$スフィア$$ on the line!」

593:t_112:1.en:
$n
「$$アムブリエル$$! If I win, you give Miss $$スズネ$$ back!」

593:t_112:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Oh... You talk as if $$スズネ$$ had been yours all along.」

593:t_112:3.en:
$n
「Your glib talk doesn't make my heart flutter one bit, $$アムブリエル$$!」

593:t_112:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Look who's got a mouth on him now! Even a poor student grows up a little, it seems!」

593:t_112:5.en:
$n
「Don't act like my teacher! Only Miss $$スズネ$$ gets to say that!」

593:t_112:6.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Then come! You put up the $$スフィア$$, I put up $$スズネ$$ as chips - let's have our match!」

593:t_113:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Please stop! We don't want to fight you, Teacher!」

593:t_113:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Quit dreaming already. The one here is someone else, not the Miss $$スズネ$$ you all love so much.」

593:t_113:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then I'll drive you out of Miss $$スズネ$$'s body!」

593:t_113:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「And to do that, we'll stop you with our own hands!」

593:t_113:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$! Please bear with it just a little longer!」

593:t_113:6.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「What an annoying bunch. Do you miss $$スズネ$$ that much?」

593:t_113:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's right! We're definitely getting Miss $$スズネ$$ back!」

593:t_113:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「I won't let you get near $n!」

593:t_113:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「Exactly, you hussy! We can't allow you to keep speaking through Miss $$スズネ$$'s body any longer!」

593:t_113:10.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「If you're so keen, I'll take care of you lot before $n!」

593:t_114:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Out of my way, Reactors! I'll deal with you after I get the $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$!」

593:t_114:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Not gonna happen! I'll stop you before that!」

593:t_114:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「For $n's sake too, we'll be your opponents!」

593:t_114:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Playing with a hysterical woman isn't my hobby, but the situation doesn't let me say no!」

593:t_114:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Every last one of them getting in my way...!」
